# book_report

Show the book whose title the request names: its author and copies, and who has it on loan when asked. With brief, only whether the library has it.

Source: `_skills/book_report.py`. Kind: phased: `PlanGenerator` runs it as bounded sub-plans, each passing facts on.

## Inputs

| input | type | default | sample | verify | subject | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | str | required | `<title>` |  |  | the book's title exactly as the request writes it |
| `loans` | bool | false | false |  |  | the request asks who has the book on loan |
| `brief` | bool | false | false |  |  | the request only asks whether the library has the book |

## Example requests

- tell me about Dune and who has it
- do you have Emma at all

## Phases

The call runs as phases only when brief = false; for other inputs it runs flat, as one plan. The table is about the phased calls.

| phase | output | runs | fans out |
|---|---|---|---|
| `find` | `Found` | always | no |
| `book` | `Book` | only when `find.book_uids` | no |
| `loans` | `Loans` | only when loans = true | no |
| `answer` | none | always | no |
